candidates.label: Quran descended on the Night of Decree better than a thousand months
candidates.definition: In 97:1-3: Indeed We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree; and what can make you know what is the Night of Decree; the Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

candidates.label: Angels and Spirit descending by permission for every matter in peace until dawn
candidates.definition: In 97:4-5: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter; peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
